text:
alexa: Quick heads-up — planning to promote service-x from staging to eu-west during today's promotion window (11:30 UTC).
ben: OK. Are we sure values overlay for eu-west is in sync? Last time chart bump changed a key.
alexa: Good point. I pulled the values earlier; noticed extra `featureFlags.enableBeta` key present in chart 2.3.0.
ben: can you paste the values hash? I'll compare against release branch.
alexa: values hash for staging: `sha256: 7f3b9c1e...` — staging matches release branch.
deploy-bot: @channel promote job queued: job_id=4598; preflight checks scheduled at 2026-03-21T11:30Z :gear:
sam: preflight: please validate `values.schema` — helm schema check failed last week.
alexa: I ran `helm template --validate` locally and saw warning only, but let's run full preflight.
ben: quick check command:
```bash
helm get values prod/service-x -n prod | sha256sum
# expected: 7f3b9c1e...
``` 
maria: flagging that eu-west has older chart sidecar image (2.2.9) on a handful of nodes; promotion may cause mixed replicas.
jen: suggest we either pin chart to 2.2.9 for eu-west or promote in a staggered fashion (eu-central first).
alexa: leaning toward staggered promote. Can someone update release notes to mention the stagger and manual hold points?
ben: I'll update release-notes draft and add rollback steps and values diff.
ops-bot: preflight result for job_id=4598: FAILED schema mismatch — missing key `database.replicaCount` in target cluster overrides.
sam: that's the blocker. In last deploy an overlay removed replicaCount accidentally.
alexa: putting manual hold on promote. deploy-bot: abort job 4598 until hold cleared.
deploy-bot: job 4598 aborted by manual hold (alexa). Reason: values schema mismatch.
maria: I'll open a hotfix PR to reintroduce `database.replicaCount` into eu-west overlay, then request re-run.
jen: plan B if we can't fix quickly: promote to eu-central only, monitor, then roll eu-west after hotfix.
alexa: agreed. tagging on-call for database fix @ben and @maria. I'll update the release window notes and change the release page.
ben: ETA for PR merge ~20m. Once merged, I'll trigger a dry-run preflight.
alexa: thanks everyone — pausing here. :thumbsup:
